title: Pure Ghostrick
summary: Ghostrick cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Ghostricks are small DARK monsters that can only be Normal Summoned while you control another Ghostrick, so the deck starts by Setting them. They flip themselves face-down every turn to reuse their flip effects. Ghostrick Jiangshi searches a Ghostrick when flipped. The Ghostrick Field Spells stop attacks on face-down monsters, and Witch, Nekomusume and Ghostrick Scare flip the opponent's monsters face-down too. The 2022 cards lead. Ghostrick Siren mills two and searches a Ghostrick Spell/Trap or flips a monster when a Ghostrick is milled. Ghostrick Shot summons a Ghostrick and attaches material to a Ghostrick Xyz. Ghostrick or Treat locks down one of their monsters unless they pay 2000 LP. Ghostrick Festival lets your Ghostricks attack directly. Ghostrick Mummy limits you to DARK monsters.
